claims.span: The FILTER and NN data techniques contributed to Method M-dynamic's performance
claims.proposition: The FILTER and NN data techniques contributed to Method M-dynamic's performance.
Method M-dynamic's BLEU score was higher with FILTER and NN than without them (14.47 vs 14.36).
Method M-dynamic's COMET-KIWI score was higher with FILTER and NN than without them (69.97 vs 67.94).
Method M-dynamic's COMET score was higher with FILTER and NN than without them (70.76 vs 70.23).
Method M-dynamic's XCOMET score was higher with FILTER and NN than without them (60.86 vs 59.77).

claims.span: Method M-dynamic improved both BLEU and COMET over supervised fine-tuning for EN-DE (25.29 vs 24.24 BLEU
claims.proposition: On the high-resource EN-DE pair, Method M-dynamic improved BLEU over supervised fine-tuning (25.29 vs 24.24).
On the high-resource EN-DE pair, Method M-dynamic improved COMET over supervised fine-tuning (79.66 vs 79.01).
On the high-resource EN-ZH pair, Method M-dynamic improved BLEU over supervised fine-tuning (20.10 vs 20.02).
On the high-resource EN-ZH pair, Method M-dynamic improved COMET over supervised fine-tuning (77.88 vs 77.71).

claims.span: Method M-static did not consistently improve over supervised fine-tuning
claims.proposition: Method M-static did not consistently improve over supervised fine-tuning on the high-resource pairs.

claims.span: improved COMET over supervised fine-tuning on four of five low-resource pairs (BN, AZ, MN, MR)
claims.proposition: Method M-dynamic with FILTER and NN improved COMET over supervised fine-tuning on four of five low-resource pairs: BN, AZ, MN, and MR.
Method M-dynamic with FILTER and NN improved COMET over supervised fine-tuning on both high-resource pairs, DE and ZH.

claims.span: gains of up to 1.34 COMET points on BN
claims.proposition: Method M-dynamic with FILTER and NN had a COMET gain over supervised fine-tuning of up to 1.34 points on BN.
Method M-dynamic with FILTER and NN had a COMET gain of 0.65 points over supervised fine-tuning on DE.

claims.span: BLEU gains were mixed across low-resource pairs
claims.proposition: Method M-dynamic's BLEU gains over supervised fine-tuning were mixed across the low-resource pairs.
Method M-dynamic had a positive BLEU gain of 1.05 over supervised fine-tuning on DE.
Method M-dynamic had a positive BLEU gain of 0.08 over supervised fine-tuning on ZH.

claims.proposition: No statistical significance tests were reported.

claims.span: the observed differences cannot be characterized as statistically reliable
claims.proposition: The observed differences cannot be characterized as statistically reliable.
